newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-RECORD ROUND PUTS COOPER AHEAD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-RECORD ROUND PUTS COOPER AHEAD.

text.p: Australian golfer Justin Cooper fired a course record seven-under-par 64 on Friday to lead after the second round of the US$395,000 Players' Championship at the Robina Woods course.
He has won just over US$1,000 since turning professional at the start of the year, but bettered the previous record of 65 set six years ago by compatriot Paul Foley.
Cooper leads the tournament on 11-under 131, four clear of Australia's Bradley Hughes and J.J. West of the United States.
Hughes carded a second round 65, while West, who had shared the overnight lead with Australia's Craig Spence, shot a 70.
Spence dropped back to equal fifth with Anthony Painter, also of Australia, on 139 after a three-over second round of 74.
